_README: Copy to <workspace>/config/itr_inputs.json. Only fy + assessment_year are used by the generator today (income/TDS/TCS are auto-sourced from AIS); the rest are placeholders for manual gaps.
_filed_on: date the return was e-filed; drives 234A (nil if on or before the due date). Leave absent before filing.
_challans: FALLBACK ONLY. Tax payments are read from the challan receipt PDFs you drop into sources/portal/<fy>/. List one here {bsr_code, serial, date, amount} only if you no longer have its receipt. Advance vs self-assessment tax is decided by the DATE (on or before 31-Mar of the FY = advance tax).
_revises: DATA for a 139(5) revision {acknowledgement, original_filed_on}. Inert unless you pass --revised; the flag decides, never this block.
